_note: MOCK CONTENT written for the prototype. The ABCD dataset lists the FAQ questions agents saw, but not their answers.

jeans.q: How do I remove a grass stain?
jeans.a: Soak the stain in cold water with a little laundry detergent for 30 minutes, then wash as usual. Avoid hot water, which sets the stain.

jeans.q: How often should jeans be washed?
jeans.a: About every 5 to 10 wears. Wash them inside out in cold water to keep the color.

jeans.q: How long is the leg length?
jeans.a: Our jeans come in 30, 32 and 34 inch inseams. The inseam is shown on each product page.
Hemming is free for Gold members and $10 for everyone else, at any of our stores.

jeans.q: Do the jeans shrink after washing?
jeans.a: Our jeans are pre-shrunk, so they shrink less than 1% if you wash them in cold water and hang them to dry. Tumble drying on high heat can shrink them slightly more.

jeans.q: Do the jeans come in dark blue or black?
jeans.a: Most styles come in dark blue and black. Available colors are listed on each product page.

jeans.q: Are larger or smaller sizes available?
jeans.a: Waist sizes run from 26 to 42. If a size is out of stock online, the product page lets you sign up for a restock alert.
Yes, our distressed range has ripped and frayed styles.

shirt.q: How do I remove a stain from a shirt?
shirt.a: Blot the stain, apply a little dish soap, leave it for 10 minutes and wash in cold water.

shirt.q: How should I wash the shirt?
shirt.a: Machine wash cold on a gentle cycle and hang to dry. Iron on medium heat if needed.

shirt.q: How long is the arm length?
shirt.a: Sleeve lengths are listed by size on each product page. Our medium has a 34-inch sleeve.
Collar sizes run from 14 to 18 inches. The size chart on the product page shows each one.
Our cotton shirts may shrink about 2% if dried on high heat. Washing cold and hanging to dry prevents this.

shirt.q: Are small, medium or large in stock?
shirt.a: Stock is shown live on each product page, by size.

shirt.q: Do the buttons come in brown or black?
shirt.a: Button color depends on the style and is listed on the product page.

shirt.q: What material is the shirt made of?
shirt.a: Most of our shirts are 100% cotton. The exact material is on each product page and the care label.

boots.q: How do I remove a paint stain?
boots.a: For leather, gently wipe fresh paint with a damp cloth. For dried paint, use a leather cleaner and a soft brush.
Our boots come in standard (D) and wide (E) widths.
Put the boot in a plastic bag in the freezer for an hour, then gently scrape off the hardened gum.

boots.q: How long do they take to break in?
boots.a: Usually about two weeks of regular wear.
Boots marked 'waterproof' on the product page have a sealed membrane. Other styles are water-resistant only.
Laces match the boot color. Spare laces in black and brown are available in store.

boots.q: What if my size isn't in stock?
boots.a: You can sign up for a restock alert on the product page.

boots.q: Do the boots come with a warranty?
boots.a: All boots have a one-year warranty against manufacturing defects.

jacket.q: How do I remove a wine stain?
jacket.a: Blot it right away, then dab with cold water and a little mild detergent. For wool jackets, use a dry cleaner.

jacket.q: Can I machine wash it or is it dry-clean only?
jacket.a: Check the care label. Cotton and synthetic jackets can be machine washed cold; wool and leather jackets are dry-clean only.

jacket.q: How long is the arm length?
jacket.a: Sleeve lengths are on the size chart on each product page.

jacket.q: How do I detach the hood?
jacket.a: Undo the snap buttons around the collar, then unzip the hood from the back.

jacket.q: Does the jacket shrink after washing?
jacket.a: Following the care label prevents shrinking. Machine-washable jackets should be washed cold and hung to dry.

jacket.q: Does the store have any in stock?
jacket.a: Stock is shown on each product page, and you can check a local store's stock there too.

jacket.q: What material is the jacket made of?
jacket.a: Materials vary by style and are listed on each product page.

jacket.q: Is it warm enough for winter?
jacket.a: Jackets marked 'insulated' are rated for temperatures down to about -10°C (14°F).

pricing.q: How much does it cost to stitch my name?

pricing.a: Overnight shipping is $20, and free for Gold members.

pricing.q: Does my cart qualify for free shipping?
pricing.a: Orders over $75 ship free with standard shipping.

timing.q: When does the spring collection drop?
timing.a: The spring collection launches on March 1.

timing.q: When does the local store open?
timing.a: Our stores are open 10am to 8pm, Monday to Saturday, and 11am to 6pm on Sunday.

timing.q: When does the annual sale begin?
timing.a: The annual sale starts on the first Friday of December.
Promo codes are valid for 7 days from the date they're issued.

membership.a: There are three levels: Bronze, Silver and Gold. Customers without a membership shop as guests.

membership.q: How do I qualify for premium membership?
membership.a: Membership level is based on how much you spend each year. The current thresholds are on the membership page of our website.

membership.q: What are the benefits of membership?
membership.a: Benefits grow with each level and include longer return windows, fee waivers and free overnight shipping for Gold members.
Membership lasts 12 months and renews based on your spending.

policy.q: How do I cancel my subscription?
policy.a: You can cancel any time from your account settings. Cancelling stops future payments.

policy.q: What happens if I'm late on a subscription payment?
policy.a: Your subscription stays active for a short grace period. After that, it's paused until the payment is made.
Approved refunds are issued to your original payment method, a gift card, account credit or a paper check.
How long you have to return an item depends on your membership level. Gold members can return at any time; other levels have time limits, with exceptions for receipts and original packaging.
